#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Utility to build a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. """ import html from typing import List # Predefined template for the post. The ``{tags}`` placeholder will be replaced # with a string containing elements for each tag. USER_POST_FORMAT: str = ( "
" "

{post_heading}

" "

by {user_name}

" "
{post_content}
" "
{tags}
" "
" ) def _validate_tags(tags: List[str]) -> None: """ Ensure that ``tags`` is a list of strings. Raises a TypeError if the check fails. """ if not isinstance(tags, list): raise TypeError("post_tags must be a list of strings") for tag in tags: if not isinstance(tag, str): raise TypeError("Each tag must be a string") def build_post_html( user_name: str, post_heading: str, post_content: str, post_tags: List[str], ) -> str: """ Build a sanitized HTML string for a forum post. Parameters ---------- user_name : str The author of the post. post_heading : str The title of the user's post. post_content : str The main content of the user's post. post_tags : list[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML representation of the user's post. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not of the expected type. """ # Validate input types if not isinstance(user_name, str): raise TypeError("user_name must be a string") if not isinstance(post_heading, str): raise TypeError("post_heading must be a string") if not isinstance(post_content, str): raise TypeError("post_content must be a string") _validate_tags(post_tags) # Escape all user-supplied content to avoid XSS safe_user_name = html.escape(user_name, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(post_content, quote=False) # Build the tags string: each tag is wrapped in a safe_tags = "" for tag in post_tags: escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) safe_tags += f"{escaped_tag}" # Format the final HTML html_output = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( post_heading=safe_heading, user_name=safe_user_name, post_content=safe_content, tags=safe_tags, ) return html_output
